question: Write the name of the supercomputer developed by Tata Group in 2007.
solution:
The correct answer is __**EKA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **EKA** is a supercomputer developed by the Tata Group in 2007.
 
• The name **EKA** means "one" in Sanskrit, symbolizing its top position at the time of its development.
 
• **EKA** was ranked as the fastest supercomputer in India and the fourth fastest in the world upon its launch.
 
• It was developed by the Computational Research Laboratories (CRL), a subsidiary of Tata Sons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PARAM**

 
 
• PARAM is a series of supercomputers built by the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) in India.
 
• The first machine in the series, PARAM 8000, was released in 1991.
 
• PARAM stands for "Parallel Machine".
 
 
 
• **Cray 3**
 
 
• The Cray-3 was a vector supercomputer designed by Cray Research.
 
• It was known for its innovative use of gallium arsenide semiconductors to achieve higher speeds.
 
• Development of the Cray-3 started in the 1980s, but it faced several challenges and was not as commercially successful as anticipated.
 
 
 
• **HITAC S-300**
 
 
• HITAC S-300 is a supercomputer developed by the Japanese company Hitachi.
 
• It was known for its high performance and reliability in various computational tasks.
